classification.difficultyReason: Sine rule for an acute angle, rejecting the obtuse option, then the angle sum to get the obtuse angle; same structure as the reference.

content.prompt: Find the obtuse angle $\theta$ in each diagram, correct to 1 decimal place.

answer.worked:
Let $\alpha$ be the angle at the upper vertex.
$$\begin{align*}\frac{\sin\alpha}{13}&=\frac{\sin28^{\circ}}{9}\\\sin\alpha&=\frac{13\sin28^{\circ}}{9}\\\alpha&=42.697^{\circ}\ldots\end{align*}$$
The supplementary possibility, $137.303^{\circ}\ldots$, would leave an acute $\theta$, so it is excluded because $\theta$ is obtuse.
$$\begin{align*}\theta&=180^{\circ}-28^{\circ}-42.697^{\circ}\ldots\\\theta&\approx109.3^{\circ}\end{align*}$$

Let $\alpha$ be the angle at the upper vertex.
$$\begin{align*}\frac{\sin\alpha}{11}&=\frac{\sin24^{\circ}}{7}\\\sin\alpha&=\frac{11\sin24^{\circ}}{7}\\\alpha&=39.729^{\circ}\ldots\end{align*}$$
The supplementary possibility, $140.271^{\circ}\ldots$, would leave an acute $\theta$, so it is excluded because $\theta$ is obtuse.
$$\begin{align*}\theta&=180^{\circ}-24^{\circ}-39.729^{\circ}\ldots\\\theta&\approx116.3^{\circ}\end{align*}$$
